name: copilot-node
description: AI-powered coding assistant that reviews, explains, generates, and fixes code using Claude.
long_description: AI Coding Copilot brings the power of Claude directly into your workflow as an MCP server. It provides four core tools: review code for bugs and best practices, explain complex code in plain English, generate new code from a description, and fix issues in existing code. All powered by Claude with adaptive reasoning for accurate, production-ready results.

tools.name: review_code
tools.description: Review code for bugs, security vulnerabilities, performance issues, and best practices

tools.name: explain_code
tools.description: Explain what a piece of code does in plain English at varying levels of detail

tools.name: generate_code
tools.description: Generate clean, production-ready code from a natural language description

tools.name: fix_code
tools.description: Diagnose and fix bugs or issues in existing code

api_key.title: Anthropic API Key
api_key.description: Your Anthropic API key from https://console.anthropic.com

model.title: Claude Model
model.description: The Claude model to use for code assistance
